northStar: One real workflow reaches a measurable outcome through an accountable operating record.

localImprovementQueue.workOrder: Plant: recover one closed job-plan draft without scheduling, dispatching, or production writes.
localImprovementQueue.reason: Close and Escape discard owner, priority, and due-time edits.

products.name: Shop
products.job: Run orders, stock, purchasing, receiving, fulfilment, payments, returns, exceptions, versioned per-order tax calculation, daily close, and a balanced review-only accounting handoff with corrections and source traceability.

localAutomation.workOrder: Shop: rehearse one authenticated order-to-close and return exception with a named operator on an isolated managed tenant.
localAutomation.reason: The next Shop proof requires a founder-selected operator and approved isolated tenant, so local automation must not spend a model call pretending it can complete it.

products.nextGate: Repeat one authenticated order-to-close and return-exception pilot on an isolated hosted tenant with a named operator, baseline, and five-day evidence plan.

products.name: Plant
products.job: Run jobs, accountable short closes, output, job-linked material use, quality, equipment observations, maintenance, and shift exceptions from one plant record.

localAutomation.workOrder: Plant: validate one order-bound OEE window with an operator and supervisor on an isolated managed tenant.
localAutomation.reason: The Plant evidence gate needs named human timing evidence and an approved managed tenant; automation cannot manufacture either input.

products.nextGate: Validate one order-bound OEE window with an operator and supervisor on an isolated managed tenant, reconcile the exact work-centre downtime source, and measure correction effort before adding costing or calibration adapters.

products.name: Website
products.job: Turn an approved business brief into a finite, reviewable website and one deterministic downloadable site file.

localAutomation.workOrder: Website: run one named business brief through responsive review and retain the accepted managed artifact.
localAutomation.reason: A real named business brief and accepted owner review are missing, so a generated sample cannot truthfully close the Website gate.

products.nextGate: Complete one named-business brief through accepted responsive preview and retained managed artifact before connecting domain or publish authority.

products.name: Ecommerce
products.job: Create a simple customer storefront from a read-only Shop catalogue, quote a recoverable cart, send structured order intent into Shop, and retain accountable post-order help, return, and balance-review outcomes while Shop remains the only order, stock, payment, refund, tax, and correction authority.

localAutomation.workOrder: Ecommerce: prove checkout, acknowledgement, contact or delivery correction, and Shop replacement review with a named operator on one isolated managed tenant.
localAutomation.reason: ENG-146 completed the local correction boundary. The next proof needs a founder-selected operator and approved isolated managed tenant; automation cannot manufacture those inputs or claim hosted persistence.

products.nextGate: Prove the completed cart-to-Shop handoff and customer-safe acknowledgement on a protected preview and isolated managed tenant, then add tax, shipping, and payment adapters only behind accountable approval and duplicate-safe recovery.

sharedCapabilities.name: AI assistance
sharedCapabilities.job: Prepare bounded, reviewable work inside Shop, Plant, Website, and Ecommerce from approved records.
sharedCapabilities.nextGate: Pass the server-only golden-set evaluation for Order Intake with provenance, zero side effects, human review, and measured correction effort before exposing an interactive capability.

internalSystems.name: SuperMega HQ
internalSystems.job: Coordinate Product, Engineering, Growth, Finance, evidence, exceptions, and owner decisions for SuperMega itself.

internalSystems.name: R&D and resource intelligence
internalSystems.job: Discover, verify, test, compare, and convert useful resources into reusable implementation guidance.

researchGates.gate: Compare Vercel Workflows with the existing Cloud Tasks runtime using one approval-wait use case.
Adopt only after the existing fixture corpus, server-only structured output, provenance, budget, human review, and zero-side-effect checks pass.
Redact customer content and correlate request, workflow, model, tool, and database operations.
Adopt TanStack Table or virtualization only after measured row volume exceeds the native interface.
Add only when simultaneous operators create a measured refresh problem.
Reconsider only if the existing relational system of record and worker runtime cannot meet a documented requirement.

nonGoals: Commerce or Production as public product names
Fake autonomous employees or unreviewed external actions
Duplicate Shop and Ecommerce back offices
One page or domain per capability
